response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced, versatile software engineer with strong systems and low-latency experience (notably in D), plus a personal geospatial GIS project, but his day-to-day skill set is overwhelmingly TypeScript/Node.js/web-focused with minimal recent C++ or Rust work (last significant C/C++ was around 2015 at National Instruments). The role requires modern C++/Rust expertise, distributed-systems fault tolerance, and navigation/routing pipeline experience, none of which are strongly evidenced in the last decade of his career despite the geospatial side project being a plus.
strengths: Extensive full-stack and systems experience across many languages and paradigms, including performance-sensitive D work
Founder of an open-source Geo-Data platform (GISCollective), showing genuine geospatial domain interest
Strong track record of technical leadership, mentoring, and infrastructure/devops work
concerns: Minimal recent hands-on C++ experience (last substantial use ~2014-2015), no mention of Rust
No direct experience with routing/navigation pipelines, tiling systems, or real-time traffic data integration
Career trajectory has moved toward web/product engineering (TypeScript/Node.js) rather than low-level systems or distributed infrastructure

key_factors.factor: Personal geospatial project and low-latency systems background
